Q201.why: Ideal-diode FET fed by J910: sources (VBAT_IN) face west to the boss, tab (VBAT_D) faces the shunt. The mirror image of Q202 about x 155 (D20 A).

Q202.why: Ideal-diode FET fed by J901, Q201 turned 180° about x 155: sources face east to J901, tab faces the shunt; its tab pad is Q201's mirrored exactly (D20 A).

Q203.why: Load-disconnect FET, west of the shunt: tab (VBAT_Q2D) faces F2, sources (VBAT_PROT) face west to the plane vias and the In3 corridor south to U601/U701 (D20 A).

Q204.why: Load-disconnect FET, Q203 turned 180° about x 155; sources (VBAT_PROT) east toward U801 (D20 A).

U201.why: LM74910H in the column between the disconnect FETs, north of the shunt: CS pins (19/20) face R201 2–6 mm away; DGATE west, HGATE east; its signals escape north to the In2 signal window. DGATE is about 50 mm routed to each ideal-diode FET (TI asks for short; D20 notes it).

U202.why: INA228 in the same column, east of U201: IN+/IN- (pins 10/9) face R201's sense pads, SDA/SCL face north to escape.
